claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of Milan, near the Piazza del Duomo and the Quadrilatero della Moda fashion district.

findings.quote: is located in the heart of the city, near the Piazza del Duomo and the Quadrilatero della Moda

claims.text: The hotel is minutes from the Duomo and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, with easy access to La Scala and the Castello Sforzesco.

findings.quote: Stay in the heart of Milan, just minutes from the Duomo and the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II. Located in a historic 19th-century palace in Piazza Cordusio, the hotel offers easy access to La Scala, the Castello Sforzesco

claims.text: The hotel is in the former headquarters of Assicurazioni Generali, designed in the 19th century by architect Luca Beltrami.

findings.quote: The former headquarters of Assicurazioni Generali, where this hotel is located, were designed in the 19th century by the famous architect Luca Beltrami

claims.text: Luca Beltrami also designed Piazza della Scala and the restoration of the Castello Sforzesco.

claims.text: The restored facade keeps its reliefs, including the lion of San Marco and a niche with an allegorical mosaic of Providence.

claims.text: It is the first Gran Meliá hotel in Milan.

findings.quote: The first Gran Meliá in Milan is a 19th-century architectural jewel
